headline: Fronts Flare as Casualties Mount Across Sectors
war_summary: Since the last edition the bloodiest sectors have deepened their toll while much of the map remains static. Weathered Expanse added roughly 6,300 Colonial and 6,100 Warden dead in the past day, though hourly loss rates are now cooling. Nevish Line surged to about 6,200 Colonial and 7,100 Warden casualties, with one‑hour rates easing but two‑hour trends accelerating. Marban Hollow recorded 226 Colonial and 318 Warden losses and 17 ownership events, centered on Checkpoint Bua and Oster Wall. Kuura Strand saw 55 Colonial and 40 Warden casualties alongside 19 events, the busiest sites being Faden Point and Talven. Linn Mercy continued its sharp tempo, posting 3,748 Colonial and 5,653 Warden dead with 16 flips at Lathair and Outwich Ranch. Godcrofts produced six flips overnight, including two bases turning neutral at Argosa and Lipsia. Stlican Shelf added three changes at Briar and Breaker Town. Stonecradle, Dead Lands and Callahans Passage remain casualty‑heavy but show no territorial movement. Enlistment spikes persist in the hottest zones, suggesting the current flare‑ups may sustain through the next day.
